g.text: Earnings in urban Sindh are widely spread: the 90th percentile is 5.8 times the 10th
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Sindh urban, weighted by household weight. 2 earners outside Rs 10,000-10,000,000 excluded.
